text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed dashboard charts are much slower after the module-splitting deploy (rolled yesterday). Heatmap LCP up ~350ms on EU canary, multiple widgets cause main-thread jank. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

alex: Yep. Confirming. CPU main thread spikes when navigating to /dashboard, frameskip on initial paint. Happens in staging and prod canary.

samir: Did a quick flamegraph in the canary. Telemetry client init is doing a sync JSON.parse of a pretty large blob during module init — looks like we hydrate a cached sample on top of every widget mount. That parse is ~40-60ms and repeats per widget.

jordan: We also merged chunked intl around the same time, so initial parse + larger payloads could be compounding.

maria: Yikes. Any quick mitigation we can ship before a full refactor? Could we defer telemetry init until after paint or move parse to a worker? @samir

alex: I experimented with off-thread parsing using a worker — it removes the main-thread blocking but requires a small worker bundle/polyfill which increases network cost and slightly delays first log emission. Tradeoff seems ok for UX but needs cleanup.

samir: Proposed short-term patch: gate telemetry init on route and use requestIdleCallback for dashboard path. Long term: stream parse in a worker and cache a compact index to avoid full parses per widget. I'll open a PR for the gate/idle approach and a follow-up for worker streaming.

maria: Please do. Can we also add a quick telemetry metric so the canary can alert if telemetry init is causing >50ms main-thread blocks? name suggestion: `render-blocking-telemetry-ms`.

samir: Adding metric. Quick code sketch in the PR:

```// guard telemetry on heavy routes
if (location.pathname !== '/dashboard') {
  initTelemetry();
} else {
  requestIdleCallback(() => initTelemetry());
}
```

alex: Filed an issue for the worker/polyfill cost so we don't forget: https://github.com/redwood/issues/9876 (adds rough numbers).

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout 3578 paused at 10% due to LCP regression alerts: https://deploys/redwood/3578 :warning:

maria: Thanks. @samir please link the PR here and request a 5% canary after the patch lands. Alex — follow up on the polyfill cost. Folks, thumbs up if you agree with temporary gate+idle patch. :thumbsup:

alex: +1

samir: +1, will post PR in ~15m

jordan: +1

maria: Ok moving forward with that. We'll regroup after the canary metrics come in.
